articles.title: Wireshark 4.6.10 Released With Patch for 39 Security Vulnerabilities
articles.summary:
Wireshark 4.6.10 has been released with fixes for 39 security vulnerabilities affecting protocol dissectors, capture file parsers, the dissection engine, and audio codecs. The update addresses crashes, processing loops, memory leaks, and a heap disclosure issue that could affect systems used for network troubleshooting and security analysis. The official release notes list security advisories wnpa-sec-2026-111 […]

articles.title: Hackers Leak Customer Data Linked to Visa, Mastercard and JPMorgan After Third-Party Cyberattacks
articles.summary:
Hackers published customer data linked to Visa, Mastercard and JPMorgan Chase on Thursday, November 19, after cyberattacks on third-party service providers. All three companies said their own networks were not breached. articles.title: Drupal Fixes Critical RCE Flaw That Could Let Unauthenticated Hackers Take Over Websites
articles.summary:
Drupal released security updates on November 18 to fix a critical flaw that could let attackers take over vulnerable websites without logging in. The bug, tracked as CVE-2026-132165, affects the installer included with Drupal core.
